zones_new.introduced_by: Config/gating fixes landed in the 083aa6e..HEAD wave: pipeline_config was frozen at import time while gates.py (BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE), tree_split.py (LEAF_SPLIT_RATIO), and indexer.py (PRE_GARBLE_FORCE_OCR_ENABLED) kept live os.environ re-reads with divergent truthiness parsing, so the snapshot and the runtime values can disagree and the import-time PASS_MAX_LEAF_RATIO <= LEAF_SPLIT_RATIO invariant guards a value nothing uses.

recommended_next: Treat this as a regressed cycle: 2 zones regressed (one High->Critical escalation), 2 stalled, 1 new zone introduced by the fix wave, and only -2 net bugs across 8 zones. Wiring is clean (5/5 new symbols wired, 0 orphans), so the bottleneck is architectural, not integration. Order of work: (1) STOP the fix-one-miss-other pattern by implementing the already-written simplification proposals instead of adding more point patches -- four proposals have now gone unimplemented across multiple cycles. (2) Zone 'Split verdict authority: five writers over two stores' first (2 eng-days, low-medium risk, escalated to Critical, and the false comment in registry_backfill/backfill.py:145 means engineers are actively reasoning from a wrong model of save_doc_meta): strip 'verdict' from save_doc_meta's mergeable set, make registry_mirror.py the sole required mirror, delete the sidecar self-heal writes in backfill.py:161/323 and promotion_sweep.py:124/141. (3) Zone 'Config-layer bifurcation' next (1 eng-day, low risk, brand-new so no chronic entrenchment): route all three call sites through pipeline_config, export a single envbool parser, land the CI grep guard so the pattern cannot recur. (4) Zone 'Ordered-policy converter chain' is an HR4 licensing exposure and has now been stalled for a full cycle -- the RETRY branch's bare `continue` advances idx instead of retrying, so the first transient primary-converter failure walks past BLOCK_AGPL into an AGPL converter. Do it as its own isolated commit series with characterization tests over the full boolean matrix and a dedicated AGPL sign-off; do NOT batch it with other zone fixes. (5) The two Critical chronic zones (ExtractionState multi-writer, 7+ cycles of verdict-gate churn; NFKC null-detector lattice, chronic since 2026-07-27) must get their structural proposals (single finalize_gate_and_route writer; single pre-NFKC presentation_forms_signal on ExtractionState) rather than another round of incremental bug shaving -- both have shown bug_count decreasing while severity stays Critical, which is the signature of symptom removal without mechanism removal. (6) Re-verify the historically-unwired compliance surfaces the current wiring audit did not cover: the 11 _erase_* erasure-cascade functions (HR2/GDPR) and validate_hr3_compliance (HR3/PII egress) were reported unwired in prior cycles and are not confirmed wired by this cycle's HEAD~15..HEAD-scoped audit. Re-run a full-repo (not diff-scoped) wiring check on those before declaring any cycle complete. (7) Re-audit after implementing proposals 2 and 3; do not open new fix waves against zones 1, 2, 4, or 7 until their proposals land.
